title: Nadigan
desc: Desperate for money, a man poses as an elderly tutor for two young women. Later, he catches feelings for one of them while also wooing their guardian at the same time.

title: Sema Ragalai
desc: In order to go abroad in search of his dream job, Satya agrees to kidnap his friend's lover. However, he abducts the wrong woman and is stuck with her.

title: Vellore Mavattam
desc: Muthukumar becomes an IPS officer and is posted in his own district. In spite of facing problems from the local politicians for being honest, he vows to change the corrupt system.

title: Ponniyin Selvan
desc: On the orders of crown prince and his friend Aditha Karikalan, Vallavaraiyan Vandiyadevan embarks on a mission to deliver a message where he discovers several conspiracies against the throne.

title: Panchalankurichi
desc: Raised under Mayandi's roof, Kittan finds himself at odds with the family's rival, Kali. However, a budding romance threatens to complicate matters further.
